# An operation whose success holds no JSON answers nothing a function could
# return: left out.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": DELETE /thing is left out: its 204 response holds no JSON'
stderr 'app.sngl:4:16: unknown component'

-- app.sngl --
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func ask() {
    var r = api.deleteThingCall()
}
-- api.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
servers:
- url: https://api.example
paths:
  /thing:
    delete:
      operationId: deleteThing
      responses:
        '204': {description: ''}
